View our Memberships here Best Medical Spa in Portsmouth, NH Preserving Your Natural Beauty Hera is a boutique medical spa focused on non-invasive medical aesthetic treatments for anti-aging, skin health, and overall wellness. Services we offer include injectables (e.g. Botox, SkinVive etc.) medical-grade facials and skincare, dermaplaning, LaseMD Ultra laser skin resurfacing, Morpheus8 and Genius RF microneedling, Keralase hair restoration, Women’s Wellness, Massage, and Head Spa. Our providers are devoted to staying up-to-date on the most advanced aesthetic technologies and evidence-based procedural techniques. Our providers at Hera specialize in techniques to provide subtle enhancements that elevate your natural beauty. We are incredibly proud of our ability to personalize care so that we can truly understand our clients’ goals and make them an active part of their care plan. When you come to Hera, your health, comfort, and happiness are our main priorities. We can’t wait to help you look and feel your best!
